RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: SELECT * FROM (SELECT fieldsecurityprofileid_name as RoleName, 'Obj' as Object, 'Activity' as Field, entityname || '-' || attributelogicalname as Value, fieldpermissionid as Auth FROM profilefieldpermissions UNION SELECT fieldsecurityprofileid_name as RoleName, entityname || '-' || attributelogicalname as Object, 'Action' as Field, 'Read' as Value, fieldpermissionid as Auth FROM profilefieldpermissions WHERE canread = 4 UNION SELECT fieldsecurityprofileid_name as RoleName, entityname || '-' || attributelogicalname as Object, 'Action' as Field, 'Create' as Value, fieldpermissionid as Auth FROM profilefieldpermissions WHERE cancreate = 4 UNION SELECT fieldsecurityprofileid_name as RoleName, entityname || '-' || attributelogicalname as Object, 'Action' as Field, 'Update' as Value, fieldpermissionid as Auth FROM profilefieldpermissions WHERE canupdate = 4) ORDER BY RoleName, Auth;
